latest_release.body:
## Solace Agent Mesh v2.542.1

Solace Agent Mesh is an event-driven framework for building and orchestrating
multi-agent AI systems. It has been rebuilt in Go for better performance and
scale, with a new decoupled architecture that lowers cost and improves
monitoring in production deployments.
> [!NOTE]
> The Solace Agent Mesh source code is coming to this repository very soon.


### Get Started

1. Download the Agent Mesh Desktop Application for your platform from the
   **Assets** section below. The application runs all of Agent Mesh
   on your computer, and includes the `sam` CLI.

   | Platform | Asset |
   |---|---|
   | macOS, Apple Silicon | `.dmg` |
   | macOS, Intel | `.dmg` |
   | Windows x64 | `.zip` |
   | Linux (AMD64 or ARM64) | `.deb`, `.rpm`, or `.tar.gz` for your WebKitGTK version |

   On Linux, use WebKitGTK 4.1 on Ubuntu 24.04 and later, Debian 13 and later,
   and Fedora. Use WebKitGTK 4.0 on Ubuntu 22.04, Debian 12, and RHEL, Rocky
   Linux, or AlmaLinux 9.

   The application is licensed under the Solace Agent Mesh Desktop end user
   license agreement:
   [`solace-agent-mesh-2.542.1-desktop-free-LICENSE.txt`](../../releases/download/v2.542.1/solace-agent-mesh-2.542.1-desktop-free-LICENSE.txt).

2. Follow the [getting started guide](https://docs.solace.com/Agent-Mesh/Framework/getting-started/index.htm)
   to set up your LLM and build your first agent.

3. Try the [support ticket triage example](../../tree/v2.542.1/examples/support-triage),
   which you apply with `sam config apply`.

The desktop application collects usage analytics. You can turn them off in the
application's privacy settings.

### Getting Help

- Questions and feature requests: [Solace Community](https://community.solace.com/c/solace-agent-mesh)
- Running Agent Mesh in production: [book a demo](https://solace.com/agent-mesh-demo/)
